status: frozen before any flow or outcome data was pulled or computed; changes only in a flow-v2 file with reasons
seenBeforeWriting: Databento get_cost estimates for XNAS.ITCH trades (prices only, no records)
EDGAR earnings 8-K acceptance times for KLAC and TSM monthly revenue 6-Ks 2023-06 to 2024-06 (event dates and signs only, to check the source works)
plan: Obsidian Falcon/Engine/Options Signals.md, order flow, hypotheses 1 and 3

code.measurement: packages/engine/src/study/abnormal.ts measureEvent (SPY market model, estimation sessions [-260, -11] relative to day 0, >= 120 days)

flow.source: Databento XNAS.ITCH trades with aggressor side (B buyer-initiated, A seller-initiated, N none), via DatabentoClient.getRange / fetchStockTrades(regularOnly: true), caller flow-hypotheses, per-caller cap $35
flow.request: one request per NYSE session for all universe names, 09:30 to 16:10 New York (the regular-session request window of fetchStockTrades), so no day is paid twice
flow.aggregation: aggregateFlow(trades, { session: 'regular', classify: 'given' }): 09:30 to 16:00 plus 5 s; N-side trades never signed

data.prices: Yahoo daily chart, split and dividend adjusted opens and closes, read from packages/engine/.cache/study/yahoo (fetched 2026-11-14 for the F7 study; internal research stand-in), SPY as the market
data.events: EDGAR via src/past-events.ts (8-K item 2.02 acceptance instants; Taiwan monthly revenue 6-Ks of TSM, UMC, ASX with year-over-year sign and release dateline); EPS surprise sign from the Yahoo EPS record via src/market.ts backtestMarketData, matched to the 8-K within one day as history.ts matchQuarters does
data.links: packages/engine/data/graph.json as of 2026-11-12, degree-1 links (graph.ts walk maxDegree 1)

universe.rule: Nasdaq-listed names of the semis universe with the most graph links to semis event companies, plus 5 cheap Nasdaq semis with at least one link. NVDA and AMD are left out on cost (together ~$0.07 a session in 2024, about 40% of the budget) and because the signed ITCH sample says least about the most liquid names.

dates.whyThisWindow: older days are cheaper (2023-24 costs about a third of 2025-26 per name-day); one contiguous year with four semis earnings seasons (Jul-Aug, Oct-Nov, Jan-Feb, Apr-May) and twelve Taiwan monthly revenue releases; NVDA (2024-06-10) and LRCX (2024-10) splits mostly outside; projected cost about $29
dates.h1SignalDates: every session that ends a full 5-session window inside flowSessions
dates.h3ReactionDays: day 0 such that day 0, +1, +2 are all inside flowSessions

h1.name: quiet accumulation
h1.claim: flat price plus net aggressive buying over 5 sessions predicts positive abnormal returns over the next 10 sessions

feature.function: quietAccumulation(flow, closes, { window: 5, volLookback: 60, quietZ: 0.5, zCap: 1, minSignedShare: 0.02 })
feature.imbalance: window dollar imbalance I = sum(buy$ - sell$) / sum(buy$ + sell$) over the 5 sessions, signed trades only
feature.zMove: |ln(close_t / close_{t-5})| / (sigma sqrt 5), sigma = sd of daily log returns over the 60 sessions before the window (Yahoo adjusted closes, >= 20)
feature.signal: on window-end date t: all 5 window sessions have signedShare >= 0.02, netSignedDollar > 0, I >= theta_i, zMove <= 0.5
feature.theta: theta_i = max(0, 80th percentile of name i's 5-session window imbalances over all its full windows in the sample) (look-ahead in the threshold only; a fixed theta = 0.10 is a secondary)
feature.deOverlap: per name, signals in date order; a signal is an event only when its date is at least 10 sessions after the previous event of that name

outcome.entry: open of session t+1 (measureEvent with the public instant 1 s after the close of t)
outcome.primary: CAR10: sum of market-model abnormal returns, open of t+1 to close of t+10

statistic.primary: mean over events of D = CAR10_it - C_t, C_t = mean CAR10 on date t of the universe names with no raw signal on t (same-date, same-universe control: removes the common semis move a SPY model leaves in); SE clustered by signal date; t on G-1 df; one-sided p for mean > 0
secondaries: CAR10 minus the same name's mean CAR10 over its non-signal days (the plan's same-name comparison)
quiet distribution mirror (netSignedDollar < 0, I <= 20th percentile, quiet): expected negative
placebo: window imbalance and net dollars shuffled across names within each date (price quietness kept), 1000 reps, permutation p of the primary mean
two-way (firm x month) clustered t and 10-session calendar-block clusters

h3.name: ripple plus flow beats ripple alone

events.earnings: 8-K item 2.02 of each company in universe.ts SECTORS.semis with an EDGAR 10-K/8-K filing history, sign = sign of the Yahoo EPS surprise (unsigned or zero dropped)
events.monthlyRevenue: TSM, UMC, ASX Taiwan monthly revenue 6-Ks, sign = sign of the year-over-year change (zero dropped)
events.reactionDay: history.ts eventReactionIndex: from the EDGAR acceptance instant, or the EPS record's earlier date/time, or the Taiwan release dateline, whichever gives the earlier session

hits.rule: every degree-1 link of the event company (any category) whose ticker is in the flow universe
hits.direction: implied direction = event sign (intra-industry information transfer: linked semis move with the news on average)
hits.dedup: one hit per (ticker, day 0): same direction from several events kept once; opposite directions dropped
hits.ownEventsExcluded: a hit whose own earnings 8-K reaction day falls in [day 0 - 1, day 0 + 12] is dropped

flow.window: sessions day 0, day 0 + 1, day 0 + 2 (the reaction day and two more)
flow.confirmed: sign(sum of netSignedDollar over the window) == implied direction; a hit with no signed volume in the window is dropped

outcome.entry: open of day 0 + 3 (after the flow window, before any price reaction measured from it)
outcome.primary: y = direction x CAR10 (market model), open of day 0 + 3 to close of day 0 + 12
outcome.also: CAR5; ripple alone y from the open of day 0 + 1

statistic.primary: Delta = mean(y | confirmed) - mean(y | not confirmed): OLS of y on [1, confirmed], CR1 SE clustered by day 0, t on G-1 df, one-sided p for Delta > 0
secondaries: ripple alone: mean y over all hits, from day 0 + 3 and from day 0 + 1
mean y of confirmed hits alone
flow de-biased: window dollar imbalance minus the name's median 3-session imbalance over the sample
placebo: confirmed labels permuted within day 0, 1000 reps

passBar.multipleTesting: Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 over the two primary one-sided p values (H1, H3): the smaller passes if p <= 0.025; both pass if the larger is <= 0.05
passBar.laterHalf: the primary estimate (H1 mean D, H3 Delta) computed on the events with entry dates in the later half (median split by date) must be > 0
passBar.minimumSample: at least 30 events (H1) / 30 hits in each group (H3) and 20 independent dates, otherwise inconclusive (counts as fail)

perHypothesis: cost-aware mean at 10 bp per side (20 bp round trip subtracted from the long leg's mean)
reporting.coverage: share of volume with a side (signedShare) per name: XNAS.ITCH signed trades are about a quarter of Nasdaq volume and under a tenth of consolidated volume; results describe that sample of displayed liquidity taking, not all buying
